tools.description: Full-text search over compiled knowledge objects — names, kinds, and content excerpts — ranked by relevance (name matches first). Use 2-3 keywords, not natural-language questions. Returns matching object ids and names; feed an id to ekos_state or ekos_neighborhood for detail.

query.description: Search text; a trailing * enables prefix search (e.g. 'order*')

tools.name: ekos_search

tools.description: Run an Enterprise Knowledge Language query against the ledger, e.g. FIND Object WHERE kind = 'Table' AND name CONTAINS 'order' ORDER BY name LIMIT 10. Entities: Object, Relationship. Results carry evidence.
tools.name: ekos_ekl

tools.description: BFS graph traversal from an object: everything connected within `depth` hops, as objects + relationships.

id.description: Object id (UUID) from ekos_search or ekos_ekl

tools.name: ekos_neighborhood

tools.description: Reconstruct the full state of one object: the object, its relationships, and the evidence behind each conclusion. Pass `at` (RFC 3339 timestamp) to reconstruct historical state.

at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp for historical state

tools.name: ekos_state

tools.description: Impact analysis: objects with a relationship pointing AT the given object (incoming edges) — 'what depends on this / what breaks if it changes'. Outgoing edges (what the object itself depends on) are listed separately.

id.description: Object id (UUID) from ekos_search or ekos_ekl

tools.name: ekos_dependents

tools.description: Transitive impact analysis: follows dependency edges multiple hops (default 5), directionally and optionally filtered to specific relationship kinds — 'what breaks N levels deep if I change this', not just direct edges. Use ekos_dependents for single-hop; use this for multi-hop.

direction.description: "dependents" (default; what depends on this) or "dependencies" (what this depends on)

id.description: Object id (UUID) from ekos_search or ekos_ekl

kinds.description: Relationship kind names to follow, e.g. ["ForeignKey", "DependsOn"] (default: all kinds)

tools.name: ekos_impact

tools.description: What knowledge changed in the ledger in a time window: objects/relationships written in (from, to], resolved to names and kinds. Use to answer 'what changed since yesterday?'.
tools.name: ekos_diff

tools.description: Ledger health: total entries, object count, relationship count, and the ledger path being served.
tools.name: ekos_status

tools.description: Explains a Transformation IR pipeline (Pentaho job or SQL SELECT/VIEW/procedure) by walking the chain of Source/Filter/Join/Aggregate/Calculate/Sink/Unmapped nodes feeding into the given object, with each step's evidence (source file/fragment).

id.description: Transformation IR object id (a TransformNode, typically a Sink), from ekos_search or ekos_ekl

tools.name: ekos_transformation_explain

tools.description: Compares two Transformation IR pipelines (e.g. an old Pentaho-derived one and a newly drafted one) and reports added/removed sources, filters, joins, aggregations, and calculations — use to verify a migration preserves intended logic.

max_hops.description: Hop bound walking upstream on each side (default 50)

new_id.description: Transformation IR object id of the new pipeline's end node

old_id.description: Transformation IR object id of the original pipeline's end node

tools.name: ekos_transformation_diff

tools.description: Confirm or reject a candidate cross-system identity match (RFC 0029) — e.g. Informix cust_mstr vs. Postgres customers, proposed by `ekos identity scan`. Confirming or rejecting writes a new Event to the ledger. The only write-capable MCP tool; only Custom("SameAs") relationships are reviewable this way.

relationship_id.description: Id of the unconfirmed SameAs relationship, from ekos_ekl (FIND Relationship WHERE kind CONTAINS 'SameAs')

tools.name: ekos_identity_review

tools.description: Live NL-to-SQL query engine over the compiled ClickHouse schema (RFC 0056). Builds a SELECT-only SQL query from the question and the compiled schema, validates it (rejects anything but a single SELECT), runs it live against ClickHouse, and returns the resulting dataset. Unlike every other tool here, this reads a live external system, not just the local ledger — every call is recorded as an Evidence/Event pair in the ledger for audit.

question.description: Natural-language question to answer with a live ClickHouse query

tools.name: ekos_clickhouse_query
